name: EthOS Backup Manager
description: Versioned backups for folders and Docker Compose projects. Dated hardlink snapshots, GFS retention, quick/deep verify, a restore wizard and optional rclone offsite replication — in a native EthOS window.
author: SyncHot
changelog: 1.0.2: legacy generations show their real size and file count after indexing; unknown sizes render as — instead of 0 B. 1.0.1: the window now uses the shared AntiVirus/Domains shell — 218 px rail, text-only nav, panels, summary tiles, tables, tag pills and the same light/dark tokens. 1.0.0: first release — dated rsync hardlink snapshots, 7/4/6 GFS retention, completion manifest, quick and deep verify, cancel and queued runs, restore in place or to another folder, Docker Compose project discovery with volume/image snapshots, and rclone mirror with 30-day remote history.
